discovered.title: Choose your Medisana device
discovered.description: Select your Medisana blood pressure monitor or thermometer. It must be awake and transmitting over Bluetooth.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up Medisana device
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name} ({address})? Confirm that this is your Medisana device. Measurements will arrive automatically when the device transmits. Close VitaDock+ and disable any other integration connected to this device.

manual.title: Enter the device address
manual.description: Use this fallback if your device has not been discovered yet. Enter its Bluetooth address from a BLE scan and choose the device type. The device can be asleep during setup. A Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter is required.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.already_configured: This Medisana device is already configured.
abort.not_supported: No supported Medisana advertisement or active connection path was found.
abort.no_devices_found: No new Medisana devices found. Wake your device, enable its Bluetooth transfer, and try again. You can also enter its Bluetooth address manually.

init.title: Blood pressure user filter
init.description: Use -1 to receive all users, including readings without a user ID. Use 0–254 to receive only that Bluetooth user ID. The ID may differ from the number shown on the monitor. Changing the filter clears the displayed values until a matching measurement arrives.

error.invalid_user_id: Enter a whole number from -1 to 254.

abort.no_options_available: This thermometer has no configurable options.
